## 問題
2025 年 1 月份的有效訂單總數為多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 4089
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，待付款（0）與已取消（9）排除。以 order_ts 介於 2025-01-01 至 2025-01-31 23:59:59 篩選（order_ts 全部為 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS 格式），並以 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 計張數，結果為 4089。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_01 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-02-01'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_ts, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_ts', 'status'], 'rows': [['2024-12-30 00:03:20', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:13:54', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:17:31', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:25:59', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:28:46', 3]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELECT 
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN order_ts GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS std_format_rows, MIN(order_ts) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts) AS max_ts FROM orders
  結果: {'columns': ['total_rows', 'std_format_rows', 'min_ts', 'max_ts'], 'rows': [[60000, 60000, '2024-12-30 00:03:20', '2025-12-31 23:53:02']], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 4089
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為訂單狀態碼 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，待付款（0）與已取消（9）不計入，並以不重複 order_id 計張數。以 orders.order_ts 的前 7 碼等於 '2025-01' 篩選該月，得到 4089 張。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY random() LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_01 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND substr(order_ts,1,7) = '2025-01'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY random() LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_ts'], 'rows': [['2025-05-31 18:57:07'], ['2025-05-01 04:37:43'], ['2025-03-08 00:23:31'], ['2025-11-16 16:35:26'], ['2025-12-23 21:52:32']], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid

response: {"winner": "A", "reason": "兩者採用相同的有效訂單定義並得到一致的 4089，但 A 額外驗證了全部 60000 筆 order_ts 皆為標準格式及資料時間範圍，日期篩選的可靠性較 B 僅隨機抽樣 5 筆更有依據。", "critical_error": false}
